Strategy: Save the tightest bin. The bin with the smallest residual is closest to an exact fill for a future item, so spending it now wastes a slot. Score bins by leftover with a penalty on the minimum-residual bin, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to the second-tightest bin whenever their leftovers differ by less than the item size. It may help by reserving near-exact slots, but may fail because the future item that fits it may never arrive.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = min(bins)
    return [-(r - item) - (item if r == m else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Preserve tightest bin: penalty of item on the min-residual bin.
